title: R. Plan graph
description: `plan/graph.json`: what every milestone of the plan produces and consumes — aggregates, DataCapabilities, Capabilities, Micro-UIs, Concepts — and the dependencies that follow. Written by the planner from the design dossier, read by the watch for the critical path and, once an interface is mocked until built, for the milestones that may run side by side. A read of what a later milestone produces is a plan error the planner reports.

ids.description: Every id the plan names, by name.

consumes.description: The ids it consumes and does not produce.

depends_on.description: The milestones that produce what it consumes.

producer.description: The milestone that produces it; null when no milestone of the plan does.

state.description: planned: nothing written; mocked: its contract and fixture exist; built: delivered; evolving: its contract is changing.

version.description: The version of its contract, from 1.
